app.name: George Boole Has Entered The Chat
app.long_description:
Slide numbered tiles into XOR, OR, AND and NOT gates, and the gate does what it says to them. Every mode is a bit width: a crumb holds 0 to 3, a nibble 0 to 15, a byte 0 to 255. NOT of the ceiling overflows to nothing, which clears the tile and pays out. Seven fixed widths and a gauntlet that promotes you a bit at a time, each with its own leaderboard.
Built with magnolia, a Wii homebrew game engine by magmacrunch.
